title: R8 (security class): watch_heartbeat's tenant scoping has NO runtime assertion -- swapping scopedCollection() for a raw db.collection() handle that keeps the one-argument signature and ignores the argument passes every runtime test AND both typechecks. The only mechanical guard is a compile-time pin that catches a tenant-LESS call, which this mutation is not.
evidence: Reproduced by the checker in a throwaway copy outside the bound root (the maker volunteered it as C11 and recommended filing rather than crediting R8 as covered; independently confirmed and found to be WORSE than reported -- the maker measured runtime tests and one typecheck, the checker measured both). Mutation: packages/db/src/collections/watch-heartbeat.ts 'return scopedCollection<WatchHeartbeat>(getDb(), "watch_heartbeat")(tenantId);' -> 'void tenantId; void scopedCollection; return getDb().collection("watch_heartbeat") as unknown as ReturnType<ReturnType<typeof scopedCollection<WatchHeartbeat>>>;'. Results with the mutant applied: 'node --test scripts/watch/lib/heartbeat.test.mjs' 16/16 PASS; 'node --test --import tsx apps/api/src/routes/health.test.ts' 16/16 PASS; packages/db 'tsc --noEmit' exit 0; apps/api 'tsc --noEmit' exit 0. Restored, cmp byte-identical, mutate.mjs assert-clean exit 0. Root cause: no test in this repo connects to Mongo, so watchHeartbeat() is never invoked under test. The pin IS live -- removing the tenantId parameter reddens packages/db typecheck with tenantScope.typecheck-test.ts(73,31) TS2554 'Expected 0 arguments, but got 1' plus TS2578, exit 2 -- but its shape is 'a tenant-less call must not compile' and C11's mutant accepts and discards the tenant.
fix_direction: Two real closures, both outside D-048's grant: (a) a Mongo-backed integration test (mongodb-memory-server or a disposable local instance) that invokes watchHeartbeat() and asserts a second tenant's rows are unreachable -- new dependency plus new files; or (b) a lint rule asserting every file in packages/db/src/collections/ routes through scopedCollection and never getDb().collection() directly -- an ENFORCEMENT PATH, so it needs an authorizing DECISIONS entry carrying 'Approved-by: Umesh'. Prefer (b): it is cheap, covers all 27 collections at once rather than this one, and would also have caught the ISS-060/ISS-065 raw-handle class at the source. Do NOT close this by adding more assertions to health.test.ts -- C7 already proves the CALLER reads per tenant; the uncovered half is the accessor itself.
checker_note: IMPORTANT distinction, so this row is read accurately: the SHIPPED CODE IS CORRECT. All four operations (watchHeartbeat, listHeartbeats, findHeartbeat, markHeartbeat) go through scopedCollection(), markHeartbeat deliberately recomputes _id from the scoped tenantId rather than trusting doc._id, and packages/db/src/lib/tenantScope.ts still exposes no 'raw' escape hatch (ISS-065's removal verified to hold -- surface is find/findOne/insertOne/insertMany/deleteMany/countDocuments/updateOne only). This is COVERAGE DEBT, not a disclosure: ISS-078 was a live cross-tenant read, this is correct code with a hole in the net that would catch it breaking. Filed high anyway because spec R8 is security class and per project CLAUDE.md is NEVER round-capped, and because the failure mode this net misses is exactly the one that cost this repo ISS-078 after four consecutive PASSes. Did not block the u4b-heartbeat-collection PASS: the unit could not close it inside D-048's grant and disclosed it rather than claiming coverage.

title: qa/issues.jsonl has TWO rows both numbered ISS-360 (lines 358 and 359) -- the ledger analogue of D-051's duplicated D-050. Canonical disambiguation recorded here; neither row renumbered, per D-019. The ledger has no mechanical guard against a duplicate id, which is what D-051 filed for docs/DECISIONS.md.
evidence: Verified by the checker over the FULL ledger union (qa/issues.jsonl plus all 15 qa/issues.*.jsonl shards, 418 rows, every row parsed): ISS-360 is the ONLY duplicate id in the entire ledger. Line 358 = feature 'meeting-bot-capture', obs-windows launch() bring-up-diagnostics test is load-flaky under 'pnpm -r test', passes standalone. Line 359 = feature 'u4b-watch-heartbeat-alert', u4b's 5 pure heartbeat functions have no committed regression test. Citations checked before choosing a disposition: line 359 is cited by docs/DECISIONS.md:901 and :915 (D-048 Links), qa/manifests/u4b-watch-heartbeat-alert.md:453, qa/verdicts/u4b-watch-heartbeat-alert.md:85/96/98, scripts/watch/lib/heartbeat.mjs:14, scripts/watch/lib/heartbeat.test.mjs:4/8/10/42/53/57/64/69/92 and scripts/watch/run-watch.mjs:110; line 358 is cited by docs/DECISIONS.md:1027 (D-050-CODEX Links). Concrete harm already observed: a naive find(o => o.id === 'ISS-360') returns line 358, which has NO reproductions field at all, so D-015's measurement rule would silently have had nothing to measure against.
fix_direction: CANONICAL DISAMBIGUATION, in force from verdict qa/verdicts/u4b-heartbeat-collection.md onward -- cite these names, never a bare ISS-360: 'ISS-360-OBSFLAKE' = line 358 (meeting-bot-capture, obs-windows load flake, status open); 'ISS-360-HEARTBEAT' = line 359 (u4b-watch-heartbeat-alert, uncommitted heartbeat test, status fixed by u4b-heartbeat-collection). Renumbering is REJECTED for the reason D-019 gives and D-051 applied: it would silently repoint citations already committed in a decision entry, two manifests, two verdicts and three source files, and a reader who follows a citation to the wrong row with no warning is worse off than one who is told to disambiguate. The REMAINING work is prevention, mirroring what D-051 filed for the DECISIONS allocator: a lint-level check that fails on any duplicate id across the ledger UNION (qa/issues.jsonl plus qa/issues.*.jsonl), wired into pnpm lint:structure. Note the union scope is load-bearing -- D-019 makes a lane shard a shard, not a private copy, so a per-file check would miss a cross-shard collision.
checker_note: Filed medium, not high: the ambiguity itself is resolved by the mapping above, so the residual exposure is the absence of a mechanical guard rather than a live wrong reference. It is not LOW because of what it corrodes -- D-015 requires a fix to be measured against its issue's own recorded reproductions, and that rule is only as strong as the id resolving to one row. Same defect class as D-051, in the ledger this time; D-019 predicted this shape of failure for the ledger and it has now happened. The maker handed this over rather than writing to the ledger itself, which was correct (checker is the ledger's single writer, and the branch name worktree-agent-a39d65b2d77302c20 is a poor lane suffix).

title: R2's last link is unmet and has NO gate file: a silent watcher reaches console.error in the API's ops log, not TelegramNotifier.notifyWatchSilent -- and nothing schedules the /health probe that runs the detector, so as shipped an operator receives no new signal at all. R2 stands at 0.5/1. Needs an Approver decision among three named options.
evidence: The blocker is a genuine standing-rule contradiction, ruled REAL by the checker rather than accepted from the manifest. (1) .dependency-cruiser.cjs rule 'apps-only-ask-ingest-index-ai-db-core', severity error, from '^apps/([^/]+)/' to '^packages/(?!(?:ask|ingest|index|ai|db|core)/)|^apps/(?!$1/)|^workers/'; resolved for apps/api and evaluated against the real target: packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/telegram-alerts.ts -> FORBIDDEN true, while controls packages/db, packages/core, packages/index all -> false. (2) notifyWatchSilent exists only at packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/telegram-alerts.ts:95 (declaration) and :183 (implementation); every non-comment reference to createTelegramNotifier is inside packages/meeting-bot itself or in scripts/watch/run-watch.mjs, and scripts/ is outside depcruise's scanned roots ('depcruise ... packages apps workers'), which is exactly why the script can reach it and apps/ cannot. (3) depcruise runs inside 'pnpm lint:structure', so the violation is a hard failure, not advisory. Meanwhile D-048 REQUIRES the detector in apps/api/src/routes/health.ts. (4) Separately verified: nothing in this repo schedules /health -- no cron, no uptime monitor, no Task Scheduler entry calls it, so detectSilentWatchers runs only when something probes the route. (5) The write leg is also unproven at runtime: no test connects to Mongo, so markHeartbeat has never executed (not attempted -- production Mongo is read-only by construction).
fix_direction: An Approver call among the three the maker correctly declined to pick unilaterally: (1) a generic notifier interface in an allowed package (packages/core/src/domain/ or a new packages/notify) that both meeting-bot and apps/api depend on -- NEW FILES, needs a grant; (2) add meeting-bot to apps' allowed list in .dependency-cruiser.cjs -- an ENFORCEMENT PATH needing 'Approved-by: Umesh', and it inverts ARCHITECTURE section 5's dependency direction; (3) move the detector into a separately-running script that may import both -- contradicts D-048's reasoned choice of health.ts. Option (1) is recommended: it also closes the duplicate staleness rule (health.ts's isStale is a second implementation of heartbeat.mjs's isHeartbeatStale, held in agreement only by health.test.ts's nine-case drift pin) and the THIRD-READER hazard for U4d (WATCH_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS already has two independently written 1h fallbacks, in heartbeat.mjs:25-26 and production.ts's createMongoWatchSilenceDeps). Whichever is chosen, OPEN A qa/gates/ FILE FOR IT: the u4b-heartbeat-collection manifest's HUMAN_GATE item 1 has qa/gates/u4b-heartbeat-schema-fixtures.md, but item 2 (this one) has no gate file at all, which is the D-006 failure mode -- an approval question living only in a manifest prose section that merges and is forgotten. Also needs: whoever wires the notifier must ALSO arrange for /health to be probed (U6's Task Scheduler work, gated separately per D-048) or the detector never runs.
checker_note: NOT a defect in the unit and did NOT block its PASS. The detector is fully injectable with a signature the checker verified to be structurally identical to TelegramNotifier's method, so a real notifier satisfies it with zero imports and wiring is one line at whichever composition root the decision names -- that is the right holding position, not a dodge, and the gap is disclosed in THREE places in code (manifest section 6, production.ts's createMongoWatchSilenceDeps JSDoc, health.ts's WatchSilenceDeps doc comment). Filed high because R2 is the requirement D-046 calls 'the one that carries the feature' and spec R2 calls 'the load-bearing one', and because scoring it 0.5/1 could be misread as half the value shipping: with no notifier and no scheduler, the delivery half AND the triggering half are both zero today. The detection half is real and was independently falsified (C1-C9, nine mutations each reddening its own named check). This row exists so the other half is tracked on the ledger rather than in prose.

title: 'pnpm run test:lint' joins 'pnpm -r test' as a gate whose red cannot be distinguished from a real regression: start-record-detached.test.mjs's backslash/quote-in-title case is load-flaky under the 11-file concurrent node --test run and passes standalone. Same class as ISS-360-OBSFLAKE, different runner.
evidence: Checker's own run of 'pnpm run test:lint' on the u4b-heartbeat-collection worktree at 90897a3: 106 tests, 104 pass, 2 fail. Failure 1 is the known pre-existing one (snapshot.test.mjs 'current repo's docs/SNAPSHOT.md is <= 200 lines', failing on its FIRST assertion assert.equal(check.status, 0) because snapshot.mjs --check exits 1 on the stale docs/SNAPSHOT.md -- not a length problem). Failure 2 is NEW to any record: 'review finding: a title ending in a backslash (and one holding a quote) must not swallow the arguments after it' (scripts/webinar/start-record-detached.test.mjs:119), 12922ms. Run down independently: 'git diff 0cf1b17..HEAD -- scripts/webinar/' is EMPTY, so the file is byte-identical to master and no unit's edit can be the cause; run standalone the file is 4/4 pass, twice in a row. The 12.9s duration under load vs sub-second standalone is the load-flake signature.
fix_direction: Same remedy class as ISS-360-OBSFLAKE: make the assertion wait on an observable state transition rather than on a wall-clock budget the spawned child can lose under concurrency, or inject a clock. Do NOT weaken the assertion -- refusing to swallow arguments after a backslash-terminated title is the whole point of the case.
checker_note: Filed low, ledger entry only, never a pulled unit (D-013 severity gate). Recorded for two reasons: it explains a discrepancy in the u4b-heartbeat-collection manifest, which reported test:lint at 105/106 with 1 fail while the checker measured 104/106 with 2 -- both counts are honest and this flake is the difference; and it means the repo now has TWO concurrent-runner gates ('pnpm -r test' and 'pnpm run test:lint') whose reds need a per-file re-run before they can be believed. Not attributed to u4b-heartbeat-collection, which never touched the file.
